scope.boundary: This packet identifies product structure, dated disclosed costs, risks and category-level mechanics. It does not select a product, prescribe an action, forecast a result, or establish current tradability.

lean_research_core.basis: The exact five-code C30 set was fixed before calculation. C31 leaves it unchanged and rejects automatic substitution.

universal_market_mechanics.bond_etf_value_system: The FAQ distinguishes secondary-market price from off-exchange NAV; neither is interchangeable with IOPV.
not_product_level_confirmation: quotes, depth, spread or fill quality
actual fees, taxes or market impact
universal_market_mechanics.fail_closed_rule: If a future paper record lacks current documents, market status, quote, IOPV where applicable, lot/tick, estimated friction or settlement fields, record no_action rather than infer the missing field.

verified: Six R4 master-response codes—five actual-core codes plus non-core 510500—had one-row SSE FUND_LIST master responses captured on 2026-08-15.
Each product card has a first-party dated product summary for legal type, manager, trustee, exposure, replication, fees and risks.
511180 and 511380 have first-party dated product summaries, but their full current-term chain is not retained in this case.
not_verified: current terms after each summary document date
real-time market price, NAV, IOPV, premium/discount, spread, depth, halt and price-limit state
actual secondary-market friction, taxes, fill state or settlement timing
current subscription/redemption status or channel eligibility
any future result or benefit treatment
evidence_boundary.freshness_note: Product summaries state that material information is updated after a change and other information is generally updated annually. High source primacy therefore applies to the stated document date, not automatically to the data cutoff.
